purpose: Record the institutional transition from the Property Registration Authority to Tailte Éireann so historical and current property-title sources use the correct authority identity.

primary_source.verified_finding: The Act established Tailte Éireann and provided for the dissolution of the Property Registration Authority and transfer of its functions.

system_effects: Historical documents may refer to the Property Registration Authority (PRA).
Current administrative routes may refer to Tailte Éireann.
The system must preserve the authority name that existed at the relevant historical date.
A change of institutional name/body does not by itself change the underlying property right or historical record.
evidence_rule: Authority identity is date-sensitive: PROPERTY REGISTRATION AUTHORITY for historical periods where applicable; TAILTE ÉIREANN for the current institutional framework.
guardrails: Do not rewrite historical documents to current institutional terminology.
Do not treat institutional succession as substantive amendment of title law.
Do not infer current ownership from institutional metadata.
